title: Survival Override Enemy
description: A full enemy brain with a top-priority survival branch: when health runs low the agent abandons whatever it was doing to flee, heal, or fight cornered — no transitions required.

custom_nodes.name: IsHealthLow
custom_nodes.title: Is Health Low?
custom_nodes.description: Succeeds if health is below the threshold.

custom_nodes.name: FleeToCover
custom_nodes.title: Flee To Cover
custom_nodes.description: Runs to the nearest cover point away from the threat.

custom_nodes.name: UseHealthItem
custom_nodes.title: Use Health Item
custom_nodes.description: Consumes a health item if one is carried; fails otherwise.

custom_nodes.name: FightCornered
custom_nodes.title: Fight Cornered
custom_nodes.description: Last resort: attacks desperately when there is no escape.

custom_nodes.name: IsPlayerInRange
custom_nodes.title: Is Player In Range?
custom_nodes.description: Succeeds if the player is within attack range.

custom_nodes.name: AttackPlayer
custom_nodes.title: Attack Player
custom_nodes.description: Performs an attack against the player.

custom_nodes.name: IsPlayerVisible
custom_nodes.title: Is Player Visible?
custom_nodes.description: Succeeds if the player is within sight distance and line of sight.

custom_nodes.name: MoveToPlayer
custom_nodes.title: Move To Player
custom_nodes.description: Moves the agent toward the player's position.

custom_nodes.name: MoveToWaypoint
custom_nodes.title: Move To Waypoint
custom_nodes.description: Moves the agent toward the current patrol waypoint.

custom_nodes.name: NextWaypoint
custom_nodes.title: Next Waypoint
custom_nodes.description: Advances the patrol route to the next waypoint.

n1.name: Priority
n1.title: Enemy AI
n1.description: The survival branch is evaluated first on every tick, so it preempts everything below it.
